id: title:Gilbert09:accept a pasted site url for clickup and confluence

observations.behavior: Adds a regex to extract the numeric workspace ID from ClickUp URLs.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion connectors to accept user-friendly URL pastes while still identifying the correct workspace.

observations.behavior: Adds a normalization function for Confluence Atlassian host suffix stripping and path removal.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion connectors to accept various input formats (URLs with paths or trailing slashes) without breaking authentication requests.

observations.behavior: Tests that credential validation successfully probes the normalized Atlassian endpoint after accepting varied inputs.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides test-backed assurance that the connector will not fail due to malformed subdomain inputs, supporting reliable warehouse syncs.

observations.limitations: The chunk does not demonstrate end-to-end execution of these changes against live warehouses; it only shows implementation and tests. No tier-3 systemic benefit is demonstrated across multiple critical components.

review.limitations: The chunk does not demonstrate end-to-end execution of these changes against live warehouses; it only shows implementation and tests. No tier-3 systemic benefit is demonstrated across multiple critical components.
review.reason: This chunk demonstrates bounded capability improvements in two warehouse-source connectors by adding URL/host normalization and corresponding tests. The change improves usability and reliability but remains localized rather than broadly systemic.
review.posthog_relevance: These changes help PostHog users configure ClickUp and Confluence warehouse sources more easily while maintaining compatibility with existing setups, potentially reducing support burden and configuration errors.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on visible code and its relationship to warehouse ingestion; no runtime behavior or adoption data are available.
